overview: This enum tells battle log checks whether to read hits a fighter sends or hits that fighter receives.

None.technical: uint8 value 0. FindOrAddLogValues has no case for it, so AddLogValue writes nothing. SumLogValues uses SendValues because only Receive selects ReceiveValues. Exported arrays contain 216 None slots in MissionTaskDataTable and 131 in BattleTalkSetDataTable.

Send.simple: Counts what the chosen fighter deals out.
Send.technical: uint8 value 1. AddLogValue writes into SendValues for both round and total logs. Result score checks, ranking checks and mission conditions read that map. Exported arrays contain 114 Send slots in MissionTaskDataTable and 24 in BattleTalkSetDataTable.

Receive.simple: Counts what the chosen fighter takes in.
Receive.technical: uint8 value 2. AddLogValue writes into ReceiveValues for both round and total logs. SumLogValues selects that map only for this type. Result and ranking checks use it for damage taken and just guard. Exported arrays contain 123 Receive slots in MissionTaskDataTable and 3 in BattleTalkSetDataTable.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. The write switch has no case for it and SumLogValues reads SendValues for it. No exported row uses it.

notes: MissionTask and BattleTalkSet store PassiveType in arrays aligned with ValueType and TargetType.
EvaluateLog rejects None and Invalid value types before it reads PassiveType.
HitPointRate results are averaged over the resolved characters.
A PassiveType of None is a send-style read even though it prevents new log writes.
